caseName: Cal-Cut Pipe & Supply, Inc. v. Southern Idaho Pipe & Steel Co.
caseNameFull: Cal-Cut Pipe & Supply, Inc., dba Western Pipe & Tube Co. v. Southern Idaho Pipe & Steel Co.

opinions.text: Appeal from Sup. Ct. Idaho dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
